newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, nearbys falter late.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, nearbys falter late.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mixed, with nearbys closing lower on a late profit-taking break in U.S. wheat futures tied to ideas the market was overbought, traders said.
MGE spring wheat had traded higher through much of the session on concerns over tight domestic stocks of wheat.

Traders said players with short positions in the December contract were seeking coverage and trying to roll their positions to March, causing the Dec/March spread to widen to 28 cents from 25 cents. But late CBOT-induced weakness forced the MGE spread to narrow and close at 25 cents.
Traders said U.S. wheat drew only light pressure after the EU granted export licenses for 311,200 tonnes of wheat at a refund of 16.50 Ecus per tonne, up slightly from 15.97 Ecus last week.
MGE spring wheat closed 3-3/4 cents per bushel lower to four cents higher, with Dec down 3-3/4 cents at $4.13-1/4. March shed 3-1/4 cents to close at $3.88-1/4.
LFG was the featured player, buying one million March and one million Dec and selling two million March. LFG and Continental bull-spread 500,000 Dec/March at 25 cents.
Traders said Wilson sold one million March and bear-spread three million March/Dec bushels from 25 to 28 cents. Benson-Quinn bought 600,000 March and 700,000 December.
MGE barley closed five cents per cwt lower. Nearby December barley did not trade.
